blocks.text: Managing compliance workflows in Slack on Mac

Compliance work requires constant attention to detail. You must track updates from regulators and internal audits. Slack is often the hub for these conversations. On a Mac, you can move faster by learning the native keyboard shortcuts. Press Command + / at any time to see the full list of shortcuts in your current workspace.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for compliance officers
Speed matters when you are reviewing high volumes of communication. Use these shortcuts to save time every day.

items: Command + K: Open the quick switcher to jump to any conversation.
Command + G: Open the general search bar.
Command + F: Search within your current channel.
Command + ,: Open your preferences menu to adjust notification settings.
Shift + Enter: Add a line break to your message without sending it.

blocks.text: Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. It helps you find buttons or explain how to perform tasks. When you are lost in a deep thread, hold Option + Command. Ask Lazur where the thread view button is. Lazur will draw a circle around the icon on your screen. This saves you from hunting through menus.

Compliance officers often deal with urgent requests. You need to know when a message is critical. Use [pause notifications in Slack](/how-to/pause-notifications-in-slack) when you need to focus on audit reports. You can also [mute a channel in Slack](/how-to/mute-a-channel-in-slack) if a specific project creates too much noise. Check your notification settings in the preferences menu to ensure you only get alerts for mentions.

Finding specific messages is a core part of the compliance role. Use search modifiers to filter your results. Type 'from:@name' to find messages from a specific person. Use 'in:#channel' to limit your search to a specific project. If you cannot remember the syntax, ask Lazur to explain how to search messages. Lazur will guide you through the process.

Slack allows you to [pin a message in Slack](/how-to/pin-a-message-in-slack) for important policy updates. This keeps critical information accessible to the whole team. If you need to review a conversation later, use the [save a message for later in Slack](/how-to/save-a-message-for-later-in-slack) feature. This adds the message to your saved items list. You can review this list at the end of the day to ensure you have captured all necessary documentation.

Sometimes the app might lag or fail to load recent messages. First, check your internet connection. If that does not help, clear the app cache. Go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This is the most common fix for performance issues. If the problem persists, ensure you are running the latest version of Slack for macOS.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Slack?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you, but it does not click or operate the app for you.

faq.question: Does Slack support keyboard shortcuts on Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. Slack has many shortcuts that match the standard macOS conventions. Press Command + / to see them.

faq.question: How do I find the latest version of Slack?
faq.answer: You can download the latest version directly from the official Slack website or the Mac App Store.
